dogecoin.text: @SharonDelcam I set a ton of rules so that I don't see the random things others liked (etc) and I force my feed to be chronological. Then I turn off retweets for almost everyone and mute a decent number of words I don't care about (like dogecoin). Let's me see most posts in fairly little time.
@brett_hoover_wx I think it's even worse - when I muted all variants of $doge I began seeing Twitter ads about it and other crypto non stop for a week. Pretty immediately post-mute too.
